notes.title: New Patch is LIVE!
notes.notes:
This patch adds a big new feature to the game!
Now you can delete fish from your tank and you will get 200g back for each fish!

Some small fixes as well.
The control bindings did have to be changed but the ui now reflects the new buttons!

notes.title: 1.2 Update is here! Pomodoro timer and Bug fixes
notes.notes:
1.2 update is here with some minor bug fixes and one big new feature!

BIG NEW FEATURE:
Pomodoro Timer!
Now you can work along to the relaxing sound of the fish with your own timer!
Set it to  5, 10, 15 and 30 minutes.

BUG FIXES

 Fixed restart to "actually" work now.
 Sped up menu transitions to be much faster.



FUTURE FEATURES & FIXES

 Piranha mini game to remove fish from the aquarium.
 Fix the auto-save closing menus
 Fix tutorials closing all menus

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
Patch 1.1 NOTES

Fixes and Features


 Can now use arrow keys as well as WASD.
 New Tutorial menu that shows keybindings.
 You now get 5 coins every 60 seconds instead of 1.
 You can now feed the fish pressing Y or F.  It costs 5 coins but has the chance to drop up to 10 coins.
 Added warning prompt to the “Restart” menu option.
 New graphics for feeding on tank and a new updated Pause menu.
 Added chiptune lo-fi soundtrack. Can be turned down or off in the pause menu. (Streaming the music is not recommended)
 Fixed SFX Slider so it should no longer glitch or freeze.


There was a quick fix added to avoid players having their save file deleted. If this happened to you already I am truely sorry!
